title: [RoutingManager]: getConfiguration uses a staled uiState
body:
**Describe the bug 🐛**

The `RoutingManager.getConfiguration` uses a stale `uiState` to compute the parameters. It always uses the initial `uiState`. It leads to issue with dynamic add / remove of widgets. Each time one or the other occurs we call `getConfiguration` on every widgets to create the next search parameters. But the `uiState` might have changed since the instance start. It means that the search parameters are always computed like if it was a fresh start.

The issue does not occurs with every type of refinement. It only occurs on top level refinement like `query`, `hitsPerPage`, etc... It's because the implementation of `enhanceConfiguration` is not correct. With the correct behaviour the issue would happen on every refinements.

**To Reproduce 🔍**

1. Go to https://codesandbox.io/s/n15lol465j
2. Type a query e.g. "Apple"
3. Click outside of the `searchBox`
4. Wait for the timeout (5000ms)
5. The `rangeInput` widget is added

Note that the `query` disappeared and the refinement is lost.

**Expected behavior 💭**

The search parameters must stay the same after the add / remove widgets operation.

**Additional context**

> [Discourse post issue with Vue InstantSearch](https://discourse.algolia.com/t/preventing-multiple-api-hits-when-updating-geolocation-via-browser-api-query-parsing/7030)
